statuses.live: Feed is current and should drive reporting.
statuses.paused: Feed is connected but the account has stopped spending.
statuses.superseded: A second mirror of an account that is better served by another feed. History only.
statuses.stale: Account wound down; the feed stops where the account stopped.
statuses.archive: Closed account kept as a historic benchmark.

kpis.roas: A pixel or Google conversion is tracked, so revenue, ROAS and CPA are real.
kpis.traffic: Checkout happens on a third-party site (target.com, Instacart, amazon.com) so no purchase is ever attributed here. Judge on CTR, CPC, CPM and reach — a zero ROAS is an attribution fact, not a result.

accounts.label: Knickgasm India USA New EST Main Account
accounts.purpose: US direct-to-consumer storefront. The revenue account: anime, football and coffee-ART design scale campaigns plus evergreen custom sneaker, all landing on knickgasm.com with the Meta pixel firing.
accounts.used_for: Prospecting and retargeting to own-site checkout

accounts.label: KNICKGASM USA - Sneaker Ad Account (Target / Costco)
accounts.purpose: US retail-partner demand generation. Drives shoppers to Target stores and target.com, and to Costco via Instacart — the Page Deck sales sets, the scored UGC video sets, influencer link-click sets, Costco Bay Area reach buys and Target giveaways.
accounts.used_for: Sell-through at Target and Costco (third-party checkout)
accounts.attribution_note: Zero purchases by construction: checkout happens on target.com, Instacart or in store, so no KNICKGASM pixel fires. Judge on CTR, CPC, CPM and reach — never ROAS.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM USA - Sneaker Ad Account (Datachannel mirror)
accounts.purpose: Older Datachannel mirror of the same retail account. Superseded by the Maplemonk feed above, which is both fresher and far more complete (26 campaigns / $50,248.24 against 7 / $4,056.11).
accounts.used_for: History only — do not use for current retail reporting
accounts.stale_note: Feed ends 2026-05-31 and holds only 7 of the 26 retail campaigns. Kept so the pre-Maplemonk history stays queryable.

accounts.label: Knickgasm India USA New EST Main Account (Datachannel mirror)
accounts.purpose: Datachannel mirror of the DTC account. Its value is DEPTH, not freshness: it reaches back to 2023-01-16 and carries 147 campaigns against the Maplemonk feed 106 from 2024-05-15, so pre-May-2024 DTC history is only available here.
accounts.stale_note: Feed ends 2026-06-01. Use the Maplemonk DTC feed for anything current.

accounts.label: Knickgasm USA - New Account
accounts.purpose: Small secondary US account, wound down in January 2026. No Target or Costco campaigns.

accounts.purpose: The original US main account and still the largest single US Meta spender on record at $1.11M. Useful as a long-run benchmark for what US scale looked like in 2021-22.

accounts.label: PH - KNICKGASM (agency-run US account)
accounts.purpose: US account run by an outside agency in 2021-22, $420,666.79 across 20 campaigns.

accounts.label: Influencer Account (US)

accounts.label: KNICKGASM UK
accounts.purpose: UK direct-to-consumer account on knickgasm.com. The freshest feed in the warehouse.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM
accounts.purpose: India D2C account on knickgasm.com and by far the largest Meta spender in the group at INR 36.87M lifetime. Reports in INR, so never sum it with the USD accounts.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM (US Google Ads)
accounts.purpose: US Google Ads: brand and non-brand search, the VM_ PMax family across all products and top cities, Shopping, Demand Gen and remarketing. Carries Google-attributed conversions and conversion value, so ROAS is meaningful.
accounts.used_for: US search, Shopping and PMax demand capture

verified.note: Row count is the ACCOUNT-filtered live slice; the table holds 124,545 rows in total, the rest under the archived "Google US" label that stops 2023-11-24.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM (US Google Ads, ad-level detail)
accounts.purpose: Same US Google account at ad level, with ad strength, approval status, headlines and creative assets. Use it for creative diagnosis; use the consolidated feed for spend reporting (it also covers Shopping and PMax rows the ad-group-ad report does not).
accounts.used_for: US Google creative and ad-strength diagnosis

verified.note: Customer 9797311905 reports under four historic descriptive names (KNICKGASM, KNICKGASM - US, KNICKGASM - USA - New, KNICKGASM (US) - New); these figures span all four. The current name alone is 51 campaigns / $142,876.86.

accounts.label: Raghuvansh (Amazon marketplace, Ampd)
accounts.purpose: Google Ads bought through Ampd to drive traffic to KNICKGASM ASINs on amazon.com and amazon.ca. One campaign per ASIN — Chunky Rope Laces, Custom Lace Tags, Ultimate Sneaker Care Kit, hand-painted denim jackets and so on.
accounts.attribution_note: Records zero Google conversions because checkout happens inside Amazon; sales appear in Amazon Seller Central, not here. Judge on CTR and CPC.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM - USA - Old (retired Google customer)
accounts.purpose: The retired US Google customer 2769294429, migrated to 9797311905 in 2023. This is the table that made US Google look dead: it is still refreshed by the pipeline but has held no new rows since 2023-11-24.
accounts.stale_note: Ends 2023-11-24 by design — the account was closed, not the feed. Point current US Google reporting at US_GOOGLE_ADS_CONSOLIDATED.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM UK (Google Ads)
accounts.purpose: UK Google Ads, a tight 5-campaign account spending GBP 51,968.24 since September 2025.
accounts.used_for: UK search and Shopping demand capture

accounts.label: KNICKGASM - India (Google Ads)
accounts.purpose: India Google Ads, the longest-running account in the warehouse (from 2019-08-03) and the largest by spend at INR 11.72M across 260 campaigns. Reports in INR.
accounts.used_for: India search, Shopping and PMax demand capture

accounts.label: KNICKGASM Global Inc. - RMS (Target Roundel)
accounts.purpose: Target Roundel Media Studio — retail media bought inside Target, on Target search and Target-owned placements. Unlike the Meta retail account this one DOES report attributed sales and units, because Target matches the ad to the basket, so it is the one Target channel with a real ROAS.
accounts.used_for: Paid placement inside Target search and Target.com
accounts.attribution_note: ROAS here is Target-attributed sales over actualized vendor spend, matched by Target, not pixel-based. It is comparable across Roundel campaigns but not directly against Meta pixel ROAS.

verified.note: Blended Roundel ROAS is 0.58. The spread is wide: "CoffeeArt - Designs" returns 1.95 on $2,327.44 at a 3.94% CTR, while the three Manual accessory lines (RopeLaces_M1, LaceTags_M1, CareKit_M1) burn $15,636.48 combined at 0.09 to 0.42.

accounts.label: Target Roundel — keyword level
accounts.purpose: The same Roundel spend broken out by keyword (98,647 rows). Use it to find which Target search terms carry the winning campaigns and which are draining the manual accessory lines.

accounts.label: KNICKGASM USA (TikTok Ads)
accounts.purpose: US TikTok Ads, 25 campaigns and $68,178.71 since April 2025, run as link-click traffic buys.
accounts.stale_note: Last spend 2026-07-14 — the account is paused, not disconnected. The campaign-level report (TIKTOK_ADS_USA_CAMPAIGN_REPORT_DAILY) carries empty rows through 2026-07-23.
